title: Carved pilasters beside the Kimball house's upper loggia windows
items: At 1801 Prairie, the two windows over the corner loggia, one on the avenue and one on 18th Street, now each stand between a pair of carved stone pilasters, as the c. 1895 photograph and the 1965 survey photograph show them.

Each pilaster rises from the belt course to a capital that carries the end of the window's cornice, so the cornice no longer hangs on small scrolled brackets. One diamond lozenge is carved on each shaft.
